fields.label: Line Ref (A, B…)
fields.description: Optional print serial — A, B, C or any custom marker. Blank = auto number.

fields.label: Particulars / Line Name (Print)
fields.description: Customer-facing line name on the quote. Change freely (e.g. BIS Consultancy Fee).

fields.label: Cost Component
fields.description: Optional label — Consulting Charges, Government Fees, or your own name.

fields.label: Currency
fields.description: Per-line currency — change this first so Unit Price / Total symbols stay aligned.

fields.label: Unit Price (Default Charges)
fields.description: Numeric unit charge. Leave 0 and use Custom Value for text-only lines (At actuals, Included, TBD…).

fields.label: No. of Units
fields.description: Quantity of units. Total Charges = Unit Price × No. of Units (ignored when Custom Value is set).

fields.label: Total Charges
fields.description: Unit Price × No. of Units — used for summing when Do Not Sum is off and Custom Value is blank.

fields.label: Custom Value
fields.description: Free text for Print (letters/words OK): At actuals, Included, As applicable, TBD, A… Overrides numeric Total on PDF.

fields.label: Do Not Sum
fields.description: Tick to show the line on the quote but exclude it from Commercials Total / Final Costing.

fields.label: Payment Destination
fields.options:
Payable to Instacertify
Payable Directly to Government
Payable Directly to Laboratory
Payable to Third Party
fields.description: Payable to Instacertify = counted revenue. Other destinations = pass-through (do not count).

fields.label: Revenue
fields.options:
Counted Revenue
Do Not Count as Revenue
fields.description: Counted Revenue = money paid to Instacertify. Do Not Count = shown to customer but paid to govt/lab/third party.

fields.label: Do Not Count as Revenue
fields.description: Synced from Revenue. Tick = pass-through (not Instacertify revenue).
